phrasings.literal: At the m1 tag, what priority did task #291 have, and which labels did it carry?
phrasings.short: #291 priority and labels at the m1 tag
phrasings.paraphrased: In the snapshot frozen by the m1 tag, how urgent was 'Shader hot reload' (#291), and what labels were attached to it?

gold_query: USE tags/m1 MATCH (t {id: #291}) RETURN t.priority, t.labels
notes: SD §3.1 and §7 s42: tags/m1 points at c.h2-prio1, which moves #291 from P2 to P3. SD §5.7: #291 was created with labels render, tools; hot is added later by c.h2-label (s68, main~15), so it is not in the tag.

phrasings.literal: On main as it stood 20 commits before its current tip, counting along first parents, what was the status of task #290 and how many times had it been reopened?
phrasings.short: #290 status and reopen count, main 20 commits back
phrasings.paraphrased: Wind main back twenty first-parent commits: where did the frame pacing investigation #290 stand then, and how many reopenings had it been through?

gold_query: USE main~20 MATCH (t {id: #290}) RETURN t.status, t.reopen_count
notes: SD §11.6: main~20 is c.filler-d7 (s62). SD §5.7 and §7: c.h1-reopen (s59) moved #290 done->open and reopen_count 0->1; the next status change, c.h1-restart, is s65 (main~17), after the view.

phrasings.literal: On lane/net, which findings have a body that mentions 'кольцевого буфера'?
phrasings.short: lane/net findings whose body mentions 'кольцевого буфера'
phrasings.paraphrased: Looking only at the net lane, which review findings talk about the 'кольцевого буфера' somewhere in their body text?

gold_query: USE lane/net MATCH (f:finding) WHERE f.body CONTAINS 'кольцевого буфера' RETURN f
notes: SD §5.9: #603 (FC-1, created on main at s24, before lane/net forked at s26) has the RU body 'Размер кольцевого буфера не ограничен.' and lane-only #1302 (FN-2) has 'Имена полей кольцевого буфера не совпадают.'. No other named body contains the phrase (SD §5), and filler Russian bodies use only the WR list (SD §12.2-§12.3). The conflict on #603.status (SD §10) does not touch its body.

phrasings.literal: Since the m1 tag, which commits on main changed the priority of task #291, and what were the old and new priority values?
phrasings.short: #291 priority changes on main since the m1 tag
phrasings.paraphrased: After m1 was tagged, how has the urgency of 'Shader hot reload' (#291) been adjusted on main: in which commit, and from what to what?

gold_query: CALL history(#291, field: 'priority', in: tags/m1..main) YIELD commit, before, after
notes: SD §5.7 and §7: #291's priority changes are c.h2-prio1 (s42, P2->P3) and c.h2-prio2 (s97, P3->P1). tags/m1 points at c.h2-prio1 (SD §3.1), so the range tags/m1..main excludes it and keeps only c.h2-prio2; the creation (c.history) is before the tag.

phrasings.literal: Over the last 25 commits on main, list every status change of task #290 with the commit, the actor who made it, and the old and new status.
phrasings.short: #290 status changes in main's last 25 commits, with actors
phrasings.paraphrased: Within main's 25 most recent commits, how did the frame pacing investigation (#290) move between states, and who moved it each time?

gold_query: CALL history(#290, field: 'status', in: main~25..main) YIELD commit, actor, before, after
notes: SD §11.6: main~25 is c.x1-delete, so main~25..main holds main~24 (c.h1-title) through main~0; c.merge-tools (main~27) and the lane/tools commits it brings are ancestors of main~25 and stay out. SD §7: the status changes of #290 in that range are c.h1-reopen (s59, orch, done->open), c.h1-restart (s65, dev#4, open->in_progress) and c.h1-done2 (s75, dev#4, in_progress->done); c.h1-title changes only the title.

phrasings.literal: Кто последним изменил заголовок задачи #290, в каком коммите это было и какой заголовок у задачи сейчас?
phrasings.short: последнее изменение заголовка #290: кто, коммит, текущий заголовок
phrasings.paraphrased: Покажи текущий заголовок задачи #290, а также автора и коммит, которые установили его последними.

gold_query: CALL blame(#290) YIELD name, value, commit, actor WHERE name = 'title'
notes: SD §5.7 and §7 s56: c.h1-title (dev#4, D6 12:00) set #290's title to 'Frame pacing investigation (vsync)'; no later commit changes the title (SD §11.6 lists #290 as a clean node).

phrasings.literal: Which commits on lane/net that main has not received yet were made by dev#2?
phrasings.short: dev#2 commits on lane/net not yet on main
phrasings.paraphrased: Of the net lane's work that has not reached main, which commits did the developer dev#2 author?

gold_query: CALL log(main..lane/net, actor: 'dev#2') YIELD commit
notes: SD §11.6: log(main..lane/net) lists lane/net's 9 own commits. SD §7: of them, dev#2 made c.net-c1-done (s77), c.net-c2-done (s83) and c.net-c3-claim (s91); the rest are by orch, rev#1 and ref#1, so no filler commit is in the answer. The named form carries a revision range and a '#' inside a k=v token (surface).

phrasings.literal: Which lane branches are more than 10 commits behind main, and how many commits behind is each one?
phrasings.short: lanes more than 10 commits behind main, with counts
phrasings.paraphrased: How far have the lanes fallen behind main? List only those that are missing more than ten of main's commits, with the gap for each.

gold_query: CALL refs() YIELD name, kind, behind WHERE kind = 'work' AND behind > 10 RETURN name, behind
notes: SD §11.6 ref positions: behind main lane/tools 28, lane/audio 13, lane/net 6, lane/assets 41, lane/shaders 19; plan/q3 (8) is a plan ref, not a lane (SD §3.1). lane/net is excluded at 6.

phrasings.literal: For the commits on lane/net that main has not received yet, how many did each actor make?
phrasings.short: lane/net commits missing from main, counted per actor
phrasings.paraphrased: Break down the net lane's commits that main still lacks by who made them, with a count per actor.

gold_query: CALL log(main..lane/net) YIELD actor RETURN actor, count(*) AS commits
notes: SD §11.6: log(main..lane/net) holds lane/net's 9 own commits (the sync commit included, SD open point 5). SD §7 actors: orch c.net-c4-prio, c.net-new-tasks, c.sync-net, c.filler-d12-net (4); dev#2 c.net-c1-done, c.net-c2-done, c.net-c3-claim (3); rev#1 c.net-review; ref#1 c.net-refute. A count over a range with a filler commit is allowed (SD §16 item 13).

phrasings.literal: Since the m1 tag, which actors made at least two commits on main that touched task #290, and how many such commits did each make?
phrasings.short: actors with 2+ main commits touching #290 since m1
phrasings.paraphrased: Who has come back to the frame pacing investigation #290 on main more than once since the m1 tag, and how many commits did each of them make to it?

gold_query: CALL log(tags/m1..main, touching: #290) YIELD actor WITH actor, count(*) AS n WHERE n >= 2 RETURN actor, n
notes: SD §5.7 and §7: after tags/m1 (c.h2-prio1, s42) the commits touching #290 are c.h1-done (s45, dev#4), c.h1-title (s56, dev#4), c.h1-reopen (s59, orch), c.h1-restart (s65, dev#4) and c.h1-done2 (s75, dev#4); #290's AT edges were created at s10, before the tag (SD §9.4). dev#4 has 4, orch 1, so only dev#4 passes the threshold.

phrasings.literal: Between the m1 tag and main's current tip, which tasks under the build tooling cleanup #285 changed status, and what were their old and new statuses?
phrasings.short: status changes under #285 from the m1 tag to main
phrasings.paraphrased: Comparing the m1 tag with main today, which build-tooling tasks in #285 ended up in a different state, and what was the state before and after?

gold_query: CALL diff(tags/m1..main, scope: #285) YIELD node, aspect, before, after WHERE aspect = 'status'
notes: SD §11.6: tags/m1 = main~35 is an ancestor of main, so the diff is the net change. SD §5.6 and §7: #286-#289 were settled only on lane/tools (s31, s40, s41, s47) and reached main with c.merge-tools (s53, after the tag); at the tag all four are open on main. #285 itself stays open, and plan/q3's move of #278 under #285 is not on main (SD §6).

phrasings.literal: Which tasks under the asset pipeline campaign #240 were open and free to start at the m1 tag (not containers, and with nothing unfinished blocking them directly or through a parent), but are no longer free to start on main today?
phrasings.short: #240 tasks unblocked at the m1 tag but not now
phrasings.paraphrased: Compared with the m1 tag, which asset-pipeline tasks under #240 have lost their free-to-start standing on main: open, not a container, and waiting on nothing unfinished?

gold_query: USE tags/m1 MATCH (t:task) WHERE t.unblocked AND t IN subtree(#240) RETURN t EXCEPT MATCH (t:task) WHERE t.unblocked AND t IN subtree(#240) RETURN t
notes: At tags/m1 (s42, SD §7): #241 and #243 done, #242 in progress; #244 (blocker #243 done), #245 (#241, #243 done), #251 (no BLOCKS in-edge before c.gate-a7, s93), #252 and #253 are open and unblocked; #246, #247 and the inherited #249, #250 are blocked; #240 and #248 are containers; #901, #902 do not exist yet. SD §11.1 on main: unblocked #245, #252, #901. Difference: #244 (done at s70), #251 (blocked by #252), #253 (cancelled at s44); no gate affects any row (SD §16 item 1).

phrasings.literal: Какие задачи кампании сетевых снимков #273 есть в ветке lane/net, но отсутствуют в main?
phrasings.short: задачи под #273, которые есть в lane/net, но не в main
phrasings.paraphrased: Какие подзадачи #273 заведены только в сетевой ветке lane/net и пока не попали в основную ветку main?

gold_query: USE lane/net MATCH (t:task) WHERE t IN subtree(#273) RETURN t EXCEPT MATCH (t:task) WHERE t IN subtree(#273) RETURN t
notes: SD §5.5 and §11.3: on lane/net #273's subtree is #273-#281 plus the lane-only #1401 (TC-9) and #1402 (TC-10), created by c.net-new-tasks (s87); on main it is #273-#281 (SD §6). #278's move under #285 exists only on plan/q3.

phrasings.literal: Which notes that were active and applied to the path tools/import/tga.rs at the m1 tag are no longer active notes applying to that path on main today?
phrasings.short: active notes for tools/import/tga.rs at tag m1, not now
phrasings.paraphrased: Of the notes in force for tools/import/tga.rs when m1 was tagged, which ones are no longer in force for that file on main?

gold_query: USE tags/m1 MATCH (n:note) WHERE n.status = 'active' AND applies(n, 'tools/import/tga.rs') RETURN n EXCEPT MATCH (n:note) WHERE n.status = 'active' AND applies(n, 'tools/import/tga.rs') RETURN n
notes: SD §5.2: the only notes whose applies_to covers tools/import/tga.rs are #232 and #233 (tools/import/**); filler notes apply to archive/** (SD §12.2). At tags/m1 (s42) both are active; #232 is deleted on main by c.x6-delete (s64, SD §7), while #233 is still active (suspect is derived, not a status).

phrasings.literal: On main, who deleted task #293, when was it deleted, what reason was recorded, and which task replaced it?
phrasings.short: #293 deletion: who, when, reason, replacement
phrasings.paraphrased: The old reader registry task #293 is gone from main. Who removed it, at what time, with what stated reason, and what took its place?

gold_query: MATCH (x:DELETED {id: #293}) RETURN x.deleted_by, x.deleted_at, x.deleted_reason, x.replaced_by
notes: SD §5.8: the tombstone of #293 has deleted_by orch, reason 'superseded by v2', replaced_by #294 (TX-2). SD §7 s55: c.x1-delete runs at D6 11:00, which is 2026-06-07T11:00:00Z (SD §2.1).

phrasings.literal: On main as it stood at 13:00 UTC on 2026-06-03, which tasks reached #246 through a chain of at least two prerequisite links in which every task on the chain before #246 was still unfinished?
phrasings.short: 2+-link unfinished prerequisite chains into #246, main at 2026-06-03 13:00 UTC
phrasings.paraphrased: Rewind main to 13:00 UTC on 3 June 2026. Which tasks sat two or more prerequisite hops upstream of the mesh importer #246, with every task along the way (other than #246) not yet finished?

gold_query: USE main@2026-06-03T13:00Z MATCH (x:task)((a:task)-[:BLOCKS]->(b) WHERE a.unfinished){2,}(#246) RETURN x
notes: SD §2.1 and §7: at 2026-06-03T13:00Z (D2) main points at c.h1-prio (s23, D2 12:00). #241 is done (c.a1-done, D2 11:00); #242, #243, #245 are open (their claims and completions come on D3 or later). SD §6 BLOCKS into #246: #242->#246, #245->#246, #243->#245, #241->#245, #241->#243. Chains of length >= 2 whose every source is unfinished: only #243->#245->#246; every chain from #241 starts at a done task, and #242 blocks #246 only directly.

phrasings.literal: At the m1 tag, which notes had been superseded, and which note superseded each of them?
phrasings.short: superseded notes and their successors at the m1 tag
phrasings.paraphrased: In the m1 snapshot, which notes were outdated by a newer note, and which newer note took over from each?

gold_query: USE tags/m1 MATCH (newer:note)-[:SUPERSEDES]->(older:note) RETURN older, newer
notes: SD §6: SUPERSEDES #237->#236 (notes, created by c.knowledge at s3, before the tag); the other SUPERSEDES edges join rules (#213->#212) and decisions (#220->#221). SD §5.2: #236 is the superseded first draft, #237 the current note.

phrasings.literal: At the m1 tag, which lane was the net lane #700 required to merge after, what status did that lane have then, and when was its lane node created?
phrasings.short: lane #700 merges after: status and creation time at tag m1
phrasings.paraphrased: In the m1 snapshot, the net lane #700 had to wait for another lane to merge first. Which lane was it, what state was it in, and when was it created?

gold_query: USE tags/m1 MATCH (#700)-[:MERGE_AFTER]->(l:lane) RETURN l, l.status, l.created_at
notes: SD §3.2 and §6: MERGE_AFTER #700->#800 is created with #800 by c.lane-assets-open (s34, D4 09:00 = 2026-06-05T09:00:00Z), before tags/m1 (s42). #800 becomes merge_pending only at c.lane-assets-pending (s96), so it is active at the tag.

phrasings.literal: On lane/audio, which nodes have been deleted on another branch while they are still live on lane/audio?
phrasings.short: lane/audio nodes already deleted on other branches
phrasings.paraphrased: Which items does the audio lane still carry even though some other branch has already deleted them?

gold_query: USE lane/audio MATCH (n) WHERE n.deleted_elsewhere RETURN n
notes: SD §11.2: deleted_elsewhere on lane/audio is #251 (deleted on lane/assets, s86) and #299 (deleted on lane/shaders, s73). The main deletions of #232, #293 and #296 (s64, s55, s58) are absorbed by c.sync-audio (main up to s71), so they are tombstones here, not live.

phrasings.literal: On lane/assets, which tasks have already been completed or cancelled on another branch, where that change has not reached lane/assets yet?
phrasings.short: lane/assets tasks finished or cancelled elsewhere, not yet received
phrasings.paraphrased: Which tasks does the assets lane still treat as unfinished although another branch has already closed them out as done or cancelled?

gold_query: USE lane/assets MATCH (t:task) WHERE t.settled_elsewhere RETURN t
notes: SD §11.4: settled_elsewhere on lane/assets is #244, #253, #261, #262, #274, #275, #281, #286, #287, #288, #289, #290 (12). Filler tasks settled in their own creating commit carry markers absorbed by every view that contains them (SD open point 9).

phrasings.literal: Which files linked from nodes under the asset pipeline campaign #240 have a link that is not in the ok state, and what state is each of those links in?
phrasings.short: broken file links under #240 and their states
phrasings.paraphrased: Across the asset pipeline campaign (#240), which linked files have a link that needs attention, and what is wrong with each?

gold_query: MATCH (n)-[a:AT]->(f) WHERE n IN subtree(#240) AND link_state(a) <> 'ok' RETURN f, a, link_state(a)
notes: SD §9.4: std.links_broken with scope=240 returns a8 (#247 -> #306, deleted), a9 (#252 -> #307, replaced) and a10 (#241 -> #308, stale-anchor). The plan doc #254 (a6) is not in #240's subtree (docs have their own tree, SD §5.3).

phrasings.literal: Which linked files are in the pending state, where a recorded move has not yet reached the checked-out working tree?
phrasings.short: files whose links are pending
phrasings.paraphrased: Is any file link waiting for the working tree to catch up with a rename that is already on record? Which file is it?

gold_query: MATCH (n)-[a:AT]->(f) WHERE link_state(a) = 'pending' RETURN f, a, link_state(a)
notes: SD §9.2-§9.4: #310 (FI-cache-py) is recorded at tools/build/depcache.py after c.tools-file-mv, but T-main's HEAD g2 still has tools/build/cache.py, so its state is pending (tree gate G3); its only anchor is a13 (#286), whose link_state is pending. No other anchor is pending.

phrasings.literal: Which tracked files have been recorded as removed from the project?
phrasings.short: files recorded as removed
phrasings.paraphrased: Which source files has the project formally marked as dropped in its file records?

gold_query: MATCH (f:artifact) WHERE f.status = 'removed' RETURN f
notes: SD §9.1 and §7 s76: c.tga-rm sets #306 (tools/import/tga.rs) present->removed with reason 'TGA support dropped'; SD §13 counts artifacts present 11, removed 1, planned 1 on main.

phrasings.literal: Which linked files still exist at their recorded path but now contain unrelated content, the replaced state?
phrasings.short: linked files whose content was replaced
phrasings.paraphrased: Is there a tracked file whose path survived while its contents were swapped for something unrelated? Which one?

gold_query: MATCH (f:artifact) WHERE link_state(f) = 'replaced' RETURN f
notes: SD §9.2-§9.3: #307 (docs/perf/results.md) is present at the same path with a new file id and unrelated content, recorded replaced by the D11 settle; it is the only artifact in the replaced state on main.

phrasings.literal: Which file node does the old path tools/build/cache.py resolve to, and what is that file's current path?
phrasings.short: file behind old path tools/build/cache.py and its current path
phrasings.paraphrased: Someone refers to tools/build/cache.py. Which tracked file is that today, and at what path does it live now?

gold_query: WITH file('tools/build/cache.py') AS f RETURN f, f.path
notes: SD §9.4 file() on main: file('tools/build/cache.py') is #310 through an alias, with notice N11 naming tools/build/depcache.py. SD §9.1: #310's path on main is tools/build/depcache.py (c.tools-file-mv, merged by c.merge-tools).

phrasings.literal: У каких задач есть привязки к файлам не в состоянии ok, и какое самое тяжёлое состояние привязок у каждой из них?
phrasings.short: задачи с неисправными привязками к файлам и худшее состояние
phrasings.paraphrased: Покажи задачи, чьи ссылки на файлы требуют внимания, и для каждой — наихудшее состояние среди её привязок.

gold_query: MATCH (t:task) WHERE EXISTS { (t)-[:AT]->() } AND link_state(t) <> 'ok' RETURN t, link_state(t)
notes: SD §9.4: the tasks holding AT edges are #290 (a2 ok, a3 stale-anchor), #261 (a4), #274 (a7), #247 (a8), #252 (a9), #241 (a10), #286 (a13) and #276 (a14); the node-level link_state list gives stale-anchor, moved-auto, ambiguous, deleted, replaced, stale-anchor, pending, unverified, none of them ok. The other anchors belong to notes, rules and docs.

phrasings.literal: On lane/audio, which file is the render architecture overview #292 linked to, and what is the state of that link?
phrasings.short: #292 file link and its state on lane/audio
phrasings.paraphrased: Checked against the audio lane's working tree, where does the file link of the render architecture overview (#292) point, and how does it stand?

gold_query: USE lane/audio MATCH (#292)-[a:AT]->(f) RETURN f, link_state(a)
notes: SD §9.4: #292's only anchor is a16 into #900 (src/render/postfx.rs), created by c.postfx-link (s46), which lane/audio holds through c.sync-audio (SD §9.1). SD §9.2: on T-audio (HEAD gA, which lacks g1) the file is absent with no alias, so the link is absent-in-tree (detail diverged).

phrasings.literal: Which file links are anchored on a Rust struct definition, and for each one, which node holds the link, which file does it point into, and what is its link state?
phrasings.short: links anchored on Rust structs: holder, file, state
phrasings.paraphrased: Find every anchor that pins a Rust struct. For each, who owns the link, which file is it in, and how healthy is it?

gold_query: MATCH (k)-[a:AT]->(f:artifact) WHERE a.scope STARTS WITH 'rust:struct' RETURN k, f, link_state(a)
notes: SD §9.4: the symbol anchors are a1 (rust:fn upload_texture), a4 (rust:impl Mixer/fn process), a7 (rust:struct SnapshotRing, #274 -> #305, ambiguous), a10 (rust:struct Manifest, #241 -> #308, stale-anchor) and a16 (rust:fn apply_bloom); quote, heading and file anchors carry no rust:struct scope.

phrasings.literal: Which files did the run that ran in the net lane #700 produce or consume, and what is the link state of each file?
phrasings.short: files the run in lane #700 produced or consumed, with states
phrasings.paraphrased: For the benchmark run executed in the net lane (#700), list the files it read or wrote and how each file's link stands today.

gold_query: MATCH (r:run)-[:RUNS_IN]->(#700), (r)-[:PRODUCED|CONSUMED]->(f:artifact) RETURN f, link_state(f)
notes: SD §6: the only run, #1701, RUNS_IN #700, PRODUCED #307 and CONSUMED #305 (c.run-net). SD §9.3: #307 is replaced and #305 is ambiguous on main.

phrasings.literal: Which active critical rules apply to the recorded path of the audio mixer source file #303?
phrasings.short: active critical rules for #303's path
phrasings.paraphrased: Before anyone edits the mixer source behind #303, which rules that are both critical and in force cover its path?

gold_query: MATCH (f {id: #303}), (r:rule) WHERE r.status = 'active' AND r.criticality = 'critical' AND applies(r, f.path) RETURN r
notes: SD §9.1: #303's path on main is src/audio/mixer.rs (the rename in T-main is not recorded, SD §9.2). SD §5.2: active critical rules are #207 (empty applies_to: all paths), #208 (src/render/**), #209 (src/audio/**) and #218 (src/net/**); #207 and #209 match, and they would also match the unrecorded new path.
